name: r4a any operands subtract and Date arithmetic
source: function sub(a: any, b: any) { return a - b; } function main(): void { console.log(sub(5, 2), sub("5", 2)); const a = new Date(1000); const b = new Date(0); console.log((a as any) - (b as any)); console.log((new Date(1000) as any) * 2, (new Date(1000) as any) - 1); }
